authority: Keys are assigned by Rust to actually transmitted fragments after retrieval and budget selection. A key has meaning only inside its persisted request and manifest.

lifecycle.edit: Conservatively require reverification for all retained keys when the output content hash changes.
lifecycle.restore: Restore the selected revision's immutable request binding and recheck source authorization and hashes. Content-only fallback is allowed only for a unique request; identical text from different requests is ambiguous.
lifecycle.deleteSource: Remove readable fragments and managed source; preserve only unavailable citation metadata in independent results.
lifecycle.copy: Copy the exact-content request binding and revalidate source state on access.
lifecycle.export: Append source title, locator and current validation status to the selected result revision; omit internal IDs and absolute source paths.
